Struggling with hair loss? You’re not alone! It’s overwhelming battling hair loss while trying to find the right products to help regrow your hair. Don’t worry, there’s some amazing hair loss products and technology available on the market today to help treat hair loss.

One of them being low-level laser therapy (LLLT), a scientifically proven method that helps stimulate and rejuvenate your hair follicles, giving them increased energy and blood flow through stimulation. It’s completely painless and non-invasive, making it super convenient. LLLT has been proven to treat hair loss and make hair thicker, fuller, and healthier. This LLLT technology can be used in the comfort of your own home and it’s safe and effective!

There are several LLLT products on the market today claiming to be the best at producing thicker, stronger, and healthier hair. But the truth is, some of these laser caps can’t keep up with others. In this article, we’ll discuss in depth the Theradome laser helmet review as it stacks up against the Kiierr laser cap.

Theradome Laser Helmet Reviews

The Theradome laser helmets use low-level laser therapy in their hair helmet devices to help revitalize and rejuvenate your hair follicles. These helmets are designed to be used by both men and women who may be suffering from a hair loss condition or looking to improve the overall health of your hair. Theradome laser helmets are created to increase both thickness and density of hair follicles, resulting in thicker, fuller, and healthier hair according to their website. 

Theradome offers two different caps, the Theradome LH80 pro laser hair helmet containing 80 laser diodes for $895, and the Theradome Evo LH40 containing 40 laser diodes for $595. Their caps are for both women and men suffering with androgenetic alopecia and they offer a one size fits all. 

How to Use Theradome Laser Helmet

The Theradome laser helmet is cordless and lightweight. The helmet device has full scalp coverage and offers optimal scalp penetration to reach your hair follicles and encourage new growth. Their medical grade laser lights target the stem cells at the base of the hair follicles. This allows the formation of new photonic pathways to help restore your hair to a healthier state. Evidence suggests that LLLT acts on the mitochondria and may alter cell metabolism through photodissociation of inhibitory nitric oxide(NO) from cytochrome c oxidase(CCO), causing increased ATP production, modulation of reactive oxygen species, and induction of transcription factors. These transcription factors in return cause protein synthesis that triggers further effects down-stream, such as increased cell proliferation and migration, alteration in the levels of cytokines, growth factors and inflammatory mediators, and increased tissue oxygenation.

These helmet devices are FDA-cleared to provide safe and effective use for customers, and there’s no known side effects from using Theradome products. Theradome laser helmets are made in the USA and should be worn for a 20-minute time periods 2 to 4 times per week depending on which helmet you purchase.

When purchasing a Theradome laser helmet, you can expect a 6-month full money back guarantee and a free 1-year warranty. This free 1-year warranty protects you from any defective products or repairs needed that are out of your control.

Kiierr Laser Cap for Hair Loss

Kiierr also uses low-level laser therapy to help treat hair loss and revitalize your hair follicles, allowing your hair to grow back healthier and stronger than ever before. Their laser caps enhance cellular activity within your hair follicles, increasing hair growth on the scalps of men and women.

When purchasing from Kiierr, you can expect a discreet and hands-free design using a standard ball cap. You can even switch it out for one of your own ball caps at home. The Kiierr system is one of the most powerful and comprehensive hair growth systems developed. It has an equivalent, if not better, results compared to other hair growth caps, and even clinics.

Kiierr provides three different caps to choose from ranging in price from $645-$1,545, depending on the amount of medical grade laser diodes they contain. One cap holds 148 medical grade laser diodes, and the other two hold 272 medical grade laser diodes. Kiierr offers two sizes of laser caps.

Kiierr Laser Cap Reviews

Check out Kiierr’s laser cap reviews to see some of the amazing success stories from some of their customers. You’ll find some amazing before and after photos. The Kiierr laser caps only need to be worn for 30-minutes every other day! Hair growth has never been so convenient and easy.

Kiierr also offers affordable hair growth supplements to help maximize and boost your hair growth. If you’re not satisfied after 7-months of use, Kiierr offers you a full refund back.

Comparing Theradome Laser Helmet vs Kiierr

Kiierr and Theradome are similar in the fact that they both use medical grade laser diodes in their FDA-cleared medical devices. LED lights aren’t as preferred, and many other hair growth caps and companies use these in their product to make them cheaper in price.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees, warranty, and laser diode count. Kiierr offers a 7-month growth guarantee or your money back. Theradome offers a 6-month money back guarantee. Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, helping you to feel more confident and protected with your purchase. They will also send you a new unit, absolutely free, in case of any issues related to the cap. While Theradome only offers a one-year limited warranty on their products.

As far as laser diodes, Kiierr laser hair growth caps contain an impressive 272 medical grade laser diodes. In comparison, Theradome’s laser helmet devices contain 40-80 laser diodes. Keep in mind that the more laser diodes a device contains, the more effective they are in regrowing hair thicker and fuller.

Another difference can be found in their styles. Kiierr is designed to keep your hair loss treatment discreet and secret using their ball cap feature. While Theradome is designed in a helmet form.

Conclusion: Theradome Laser Helmet vs. Kiierr

When it comes to Theradome laser helmet devices vs. Kiierr laser caps, Kiierr is hands down the winner of this comparison review. Kiierr offers more coverage, two different sizes, a better money back guarantee, a stylish ball cap, and a higher medical grade laser diode count in their caps for optimum hair growth. Start your hair growth journey with Kiierr today and get ahead of your hair loss in the early stages!
